title: Enrich Searches Using Lookups
objectives: Verify result values and the persisted operational evidence.

tasks.instruction: The fixture has three explicit source_logs events and starts with the clock paused. Keep it paused while configuring, then use clock controls or the Interview Workbench advance action for scheduled work.
Create a lookup with | makeresults | eval service="checkout", owner="platform" | fields service owner | outputlookup service_owners.csv.

Search index=source_logs | lookup service_owners.csv service OUTPUT owner | stats count by owner. Verify the two checkout events are enriched with platform; the unmatched auth event remains unmatched.

hints: Inspect the source results and time window before saving or scheduling a report.
Use savedsearches.conf or simulated REST to independently verify the definition; inspect actual execution history and search the summary destination.

references.purpose: Search commands, transformations and job behavior

checks.label: Independent search confirms the expected values
checks.search: index=source_logs | lookup service_owners.csv service OUTPUT owner | search owner=platform | stats count

questions.prompt: Which team owns checkout in the lookup?
